candidates.change_summary: Replace the supportsInterface body to return true for all inputs instead of checking interfaceId.
Replace the supportsInterface body to return false for all inputs.
Change the return condition to check for a different interface ID (IAccessControl) instead of IERC165.
Remove the super call so only the IAccessControl check is performed, breaking ERC165 inheritance chain.
Replace the return expression with a constant false.
Replace the return expression with a constant true.
Replace the return value with a constant bytes32(0) instead of reading from storage.
Replace the require statement with require(false, ...) so renounceRole always fails for any account.
Remove the require statement so renounceRole can be called for any account, not just msg.sender.

Replace _revokeRole(role, account) with _grantRole(role, account) so renouncing grants the role instead.
Delete the _revokeRole call so renounceRole does nothing.
